Turso's Platform API: databases, groups, locations and usage for one organization.

## API key: Turso

1. Open [docs.turso.tech](https://docs.turso.tech/api-reference/authentication) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An organization-scoped Platform API token (turso auth api-tokens mint &lt;name> --org &lt;org>).

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add turso
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  turso: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Turso's [API](https://docs.turso.tech/api-reference/introduction) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show turso` shows the key as set.

## API key: Turso database

SQL over HTTP to one Turso database: queries, dumps and migration status.

1. Open [docs.turso.tech](https://docs.turso.tech/sdk/authorization/tokens) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A database token (turso db tokens create &lt;db>) and the database's HTTP host.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add turso-db
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  "turso-db": { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Turso database's [API](https://docs.turso.tech/sdk/http/reference) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show turso-db` shows the key as set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Turso).
